shared_elements: carved surface pattern in shallow relief
justification: Both surfaces depict human figures in relief and both include roughly circular disc/ring motifs (rosette borders in A, concentric rings on the back of the figure in B), but that is a near-universal correspondence. A shows a horizontal processional frieze of profile figures with garments, headgear and hand-held objects leading a camel, framed by floral bands, whereas B is a single massive frontal/rear-view figure whose surface bears isolated schematic curvilinear and ring motifs with no scene, no procession and no animals.
